key_concepts: Atoms are the smallest particles of elements
Atoms contain protons, neutrons, and electrons
Protons are positively charged and equal to the atomic number
Neutrons are neutral and contribute to atomic mass
Electrons are negatively charged and have insignificant mass
Protons and neutrons form the nucleus at the center of the atom
Electrons move around the nucleus in an electron cloud
Atomic number equals the number of protons
Mass number equals protons plus neutrons
Neutral atoms have equal numbers of protons and electrons
Cations form by losing electrons and anions form by gaining electrons
Isotopes have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons
